title: Jentic Agent
description: Represents an AI agent configured on the Jentic platform, including its scoped API access, credentials, and API key configuration.

description.description: Description of the agent's purpose and capabilities.

api_key.description: The scoped API key for this agent, used in the X-JENTIC-API-KEY header.

allowed_apis.description: List of API identifiers this agent is permitted to access.

allowed_workflows.description: List of workflow identifiers this agent is permitted to execute.

credentials.description: Upstream API credentials assigned to this agent, stored encrypted in the Jentic credential vault.

rate_limit.description: Rate limiting configuration for this agent.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the agent was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the agent was last updated.

CredentialReference.description: Reference to an encrypted credential stored in the Jentic vault for a specific upstream API.

api_name.description: Name of the upstream API this credential authenticates with.

credential_id.description: Internal identifier for the stored credential in the vault.

RateLimit.description: Rate limiting configuration for agent API requests.

requests_per_minute.description: Maximum number of requests allowed per minute.

requests_per_day.description: Maximum number of requests allowed per day.
